text.description_html:
Laurey Satin Stainless Steel Melrose Cabinet Knob

The Melrose Stainless Steel Flat Top Knob is available in small and large sizes. Made with quality in mind, this stainless steel knob has a modern satin stainless finish. Each contemporary kitchen cabinet knob comes packaged with mounting hardware. The Satin Stainless Steel Melrose Cabinet Knob is easy to install.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Melrose Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Satin Stainless Flat Top Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available in 2 Sizes:

    LAU-89301 - Large
    • Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Projection: 1-1/8"
    LAU-89401 - Small
    • Diameter: 1-1/4"
    • Projection: 1"

Sold Individually
